subject: MAP & procurement next steps - FinPay integration
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@finpay.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@finpay.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 25 Oct 2026 14:08:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + MAP draft (next steps)

Thanks again for taking the call today — great discussion. Summary and proposed next steps below.

Key decision criteria you mentioned:
- Predictable per-token cost and predictable throughput for peak payroll runs
- VPC/private deployment option for production PII flows
- SOC 2 / security artifacts and an expected review timeline (~2 weeks)

Stakeholder map (from call):
- Economic buyer: Marco Bianchi, CFO (you mentioned)
- Procurement / Legal: procurement@finpay.com (Samir?), handles standard SOW/PO
- Security: security@finpay.com (Elena to confirm contact)
- Engineering champion: Elena (integration lead)

Proposed MAP (attached): FinPay-MAP-v1.2.xlsx — includes milestones & owners:
1) Technical evaluation (PoC) — integration + sample dataset — target: 2 weeks
2) Security & compliance review — collect SOC2, data flow, retention policy — target: 2 weeks (parallel)
3) Procurement / contract review — commercial terms and SOW — target: 1-2 weeks after security sign-off
4) Exec approval & rollout plan — target: 1 week after procurement

As next steps:
- Elena/Samir: confirm economic buyer and procurement/legal contacts (if different)
- We'll update the MAP with any missing owners and proposed dates
- Jonas will follow up with a short security summary and answers to the questionnaire

Attachments: FinPay-MAP-v1.2.xlsx (attached). Also attaching a short Redwood security summary for initial review.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick follow-up if helpful.
—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123
[Attachment: FinPay-MAP-v1.2.xlsx] [Attachment: redwood-stub-security-summary.pdf]

Date: Tue, 27 Oct 2026 09:32:00 -0700

Hi Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming details from our side: 

- Economic buyer: Marco Bianchi, CFO (mbianchi@finpay.com) — will be involved for final sign-off on budget
- Procurement & Legal: procurement@finpay.com (primary contact is Samir Patel)
- Security: Please route initial artifacts to security@finpay.com. Our security lead is Priya Desai (priya.desai@finpay.com) — she'll run the questionnaire and kick off the security review.

Timeline notes:
- We can start the technical PoC next week; engineering has a 2-week window for evaluation.
- Security asks for SOC2 Type II, data flow diagram, and a short answers doc for the questionnaire (they prefer consolidated answers in a single PDF).

I've attached a quick contact sheet and our RFP contacts. Will loop Marco in once we have an agreed MAP and preliminary costs.

Thanks — Elena

2) Procurement: Samir (procurement@finpay.com) — will handle SOW/PO
3) Security: Priya Desai (security@finpay.com) — wants SOC2, data flow, and consolidated questionnaire answers

Marissa
